source_baseline: Davonium Technologies V37 full website source
summary: Robot-first welcome, hand-authored transparent SVG mascot, clearer robot speech animation, responsive bot card and calls to action, clean indigo/light themes, and cache/scroll stability refinements.
scope: Preserves the corporate site pages, product/service/contact routes, QR sections, legal pages, documentation, PWA manifest and current navigation.
Global positioning covers websites, web apps, Android/mobile apps, software systems and digital products for people and organisations worldwide.

First-visit welcome visually shows only the robot and close control. Clicking or keyboard-activating the robot starts the complete intro speech; the full written introduction and topic answers stay in site source.
Hand-authored transparent SVG mascot uses relaxed arms, dark face screen, visible black pupils and highlights, no CSS/floor shadow, and mouth/head/chest movement while speech is active.
Deep indigo-blue dark theme and clean light surfaces use subtle star glows without foggy backdrop blur.
Larger mobile CTAs, legible bot controls, outside tap/click dismissal, responsive assistant panel, and separation from WhatsApp floater.
Seven demo brands keep distinct accent palettes and previous/all/next navigation.
Consolidated versioned stylesheet reduces cumulative CSS requests; cache is rotated so updated HTML and service worker can replace old release assets.

Windows deployment CMD and PowerShell script include source-path normalization, official repository/branch checks, clean-tree check, fast-forward-only pull, local and remote backups, confirmation before push, non-force push, and GitHub main commit verification.
